cta-card-1.looks: A full-width rounded band in a soft colour: a heading and a sentence or two on the left, one or two buttons on the right (each with optional small text under it), and optional small print under the buttons.
cta-card-1.use: Closing a section or page with one urgent action and an alternative, e.g. 'Is Your Child Missing?' with 'Call 911 Immediately' and '1-800-THE-LOST'.
cta-card-1.avoid: Several equal choices: use a card block. No action at all: use Custom Text.

fields.title: A short heading or question, e.g. 'Is Your Child Missing?'.
fields.subtitle: One or two sentences.
fields.buttonSubtext: Optional small line under the button, e.g. the phone number in digits.
fields.belowButtonText: Optional small print under the buttons.
fields.styleType: Colour and arrangement; keep the default unless asked.
